reason_for_child: The parent failed closed before economic evaluation because both official premium-index series omit the same 288 bars while spot and perpetual bars remain complete. This child changes only missing-auxiliary-data handling and inherits every economic choice unchanged.

inherited_without_change.walk_forward: 90-day anchored warmup followed by complete non-overlapping 30-day test folds; all thresholds use prior rows only
inherited_without_change.funding_rule: subtract official funding from a long perpetual and add it to a short perpetual for timestamps after entry and at or before exit
inherited_without_change.gate: Each family requires every frozen asset-target stream to have positive mean net return, at least 50 trades, at least 6 folds, at least 70% positive folds, no more than 15% drawdown, no more than 50% best-fold profit concentration, and Bonferroni p <= 0.05 across fourteen streams.

sole_quality_amendment.spot_and_perpetual: Must remain complete, strictly contiguous, and exactly timestamp-aligned. No spot or perpetual row may be dropped.
sole_quality_amendment.premium_index: Left-align the auxiliary premium index onto the complete spot/perpetual clock. Preserve missing values explicitly; do not interpolate, forward-fill, or drop the paired market row.
sole_quality_amendment.basis_signal: A BASIS-CONVERGENCE-6H signal is false when its current premium-index observation is unavailable. All other basis, return, flow, threshold, cost, funding, fold, and holding rules remain unchanged.
sole_quality_amendment.known_unavailability: Exactly 288 bars per asset are unavailable on 2026-06-29 UTC. Any different missing count, timestamp, or additional gap fails this child before economics.
sole_quality_amendment.other_families: Premium index is not an input to the four non-basis families, so their complete spot/perpetual rows remain eligible.

stop_rule: Run the inherited frozen design exactly once with only the declared auxiliary-data handling change. Do not alter thresholds, mechanisms, assets, targets, costs, folds, months, or gates after observing results.
decision_rule: At most one fully passing family may be nominated for a separately preregistered prospective test. No automatic capability or capital promotion.
